definitions.full: H5500. sachah סוח (√ of following; = סחה q. v.). [ סָחָה ] verb scrape (Arabic (, and Lane 1322 ) scrape off, clear away ; compare Talmud סְחִיתָא סְחוּתָא, refuse , סְחִיתָא ᵑ7 dirt, dung ); — only Pi`el scrape clean, scour , Perfect 1singular consecutive מֶּנָּהָ עֲפָרָהּ וְסִחֵתִ֫י Ezek 26:4 and I will scrape clean her dust from her .
